description: Generate a complete AI monitoring configuration for a business: target audience descriptions, monitoring location, and query suggestions. Use this when the user describes their business and wants to set up monitoring for the right audience and location. Returns ready-to-use configuration JSON and API instructions to apply it. AI agents can use this to auto-fill monitoring settings without the user having to manually describe their audience.

business_description.description: What the business does — the more detail, the better the config. Include: who the customers are, what problems you solve, where you operate.

location.description: Primary location or service area (city, region, or country). Used to localize AI search monitoring.

target_queries.description: Optional: existing target queries. If provided, audience suggestions will be tuned to match how these queries are typically asked.

name: suggest_monitoring_config
